This class of single-seat '''starfighter''' was a type of armed [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire|employed]] by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. They were equipped with two different [[Engine/Legends|engines]]. Borvo deployed these fighters during his temporary alliance with the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Naboo]] [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]]. After Borvo broke the alliance, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] [[Attack on Porso Hill|attacked]] Borvo's position and engaged a number of these starfighters.

==Characteristics==
These [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] were beige in color and had a small profile. The fighters had two different-sized [[Engine/Legends|engines]] on either side of the main fuselage and were equipped with multiple [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==History==
The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] utilized this class of starfighters in his [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire|criminal empire]]; they were flown by his [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] around the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">The video game itself refers to its events taking place during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the invasion happens in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> At least one was stationed at Borvo's base on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], the [[N-1 assembly site]]. It was used by [[Kol Kotha]] when Borvo allied with the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. He flew it during several missions with the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], including the attacks [[Disruption of Comm 4|on Comm 4]] and a [[Attack on disabled base|Federation base]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

Additional starfighters of this class were stationed on the Hutt's outpost on [[Porso Hill]]. They were used to defend [[Borvo the Hutt's freighter|Borvo's personal transport]] after Borvo attempted to sell captured Naboo [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] and his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmates]] [[Attack on Porso Hill|attacked]] Porso Hill in retaliation, destroying a few and driving off the rest. Kotha betrayed Borvo and went on to fly in his personal starfighter as Sykes' wingmate during the [[liberation of Camp Four]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Nabooart01.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Concept art of Borvo's starfighters]]
This starfighter's first and only appearance to date is in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''.
